name: Arcade flight (mouse aim)
what: The flight model, mouse-aim piloting and chase camera of a live dogfighting game. The flyer goes where its nose points with a little slip, dives for speed and pays for climbs, stalls with a nose drop when slow, flaps harder with the throttle, boosts on stamina and throws a barrel roll. The player points the mouse and an autopilot banks and pulls toward it; bots use the same autopilot. The camera looks along the aim, with loose sideways springs, a third of the bank and a FOV that punches on boost.
use_when: the player flies a creature, plane or glider in third person and should steer by pointing the mouse, with speed, energy, boost and stall mattering, or bots must fly the same way as players
good_for: Dragon, bird, plane and spaceship-in-atmosphere games flown in third person; dogfights; flying races through rings; anything where a newcomer should fly well in seconds by pointing the mouse. The model is pure JavaScript (no three.js), so it runs on a server or in a worker for multiplayer or bots.
not_for: Realistic gliding and soaring with lift, sink and thermals (use meticulai-glider-flight), helicopters or hovering, first-person cockpit sims with a real stick, ground vehicles.
how_to_add: node tools/blocks/add.mjs meticulai-arcade-flight, then import createFlightState and createPilot from vendor/meticulai-arcade-flight/src/ and call pilot.fly(dt, controls) each step; see HOW-TO-USE.md
